title: Scheduled send windows
html: You can now define recurring send windows per channel instead of picking a single time for every post. Beacon spreads queued posts evenly across the windows you set, so a week of content goes out without manual re-scheduling.
plaintext: You can now define recurring send windows per channel instead of picking a single time for every post. Beacon spreads queued posts evenly across the windows you set, so a week of content goes out without manual re-scheduling.

title: Faster dashboard loads on large workspaces
html: Workspaces with more than 20 connected channels were seeing multi-second dashboard loads. We rewrote the initial data fetch to paginate channel summaries instead of loading them all at once, cutting median load time by roughly 60%.
plaintext: Workspaces with more than 20 connected channels were seeing multi-second dashboard loads. We rewrote the initial data fetch to paginate channel summaries instead of loading them all at once, cutting median load time by roughly 60%.

title: Drag to reorder the post queue
html: The queue view now supports drag-and-drop reordering with full keyboard support — grab a post with space, move it with the arrow keys, and drop it with space again. Screen reader users get live position announcements as they move a card.
plaintext: The queue view now supports drag-and-drop reordering with full keyboard support — grab a post with space, move it with the arrow keys, and drop it with space again. Screen reader users get live position announcements as they move a card.

title: Fixed duplicate posts on flaky connections
html: A retry in the publish worker could double-submit a post when a channel's API timed out but had actually succeeded. Publishing now checks for an existing post ID before retrying, eliminating the duplicates.
plaintext: A retry in the publish worker could double-submit a post when a channel's API timed out but had actually succeeded. Publishing now checks for an existing post ID before retrying, eliminating the duplicates.

title: A refreshed post composer
html: The composer has a new layout that keeps the character-count and channel-preview panels visible while you type, instead of requiring a tab switch. Preview panels update as you type rather than on blur.
plaintext: The composer has a new layout that keeps the character-count and channel-preview panels visible while you type, instead of requiring a tab switch. Preview panels update as you type rather than on blur.

title: Comment threads on queued posts
html: Teams can now leave threaded comments on a queued post before it goes out, with an unread badge on the queue card. Comments are stripped from the post itself and never reach the published content.
plaintext: Teams can now leave threaded comments on a queued post before it goes out, with an unread badge on the queue card. Comments are stripped from the post itself and never reach the published content.

title: Export analytics as CSV
html: Every analytics chart now has an export action that downloads the underlying series as CSV, matching the date range currently selected on screen.
plaintext: Every analytics chart now has an export action that downloads the underlying series as CSV, matching the date range currently selected on screen.
